balls.text: Vaibhav closes it out wrell as Pooran can only swing it along the ground to deep square leg but LSG finish on their second-highest IPL score of 238!
Wide boucner again, called wide again
Short and wide, Miller misses out as he can only cut it away to deep point
Back of length and angled into him, Miller pulls it in front of square and picks up a couple
Yorker around off at 136kph and Pooran digs it out towards mid-off. Good stuff from Vaibhav Arora
Good attempted yorker outside off. Turns into a full toss but all Pooran can do is get a bottom edge that de Kock stops to his left on the bounce
Bouncer outside off, and that's quite high! Called wide
Pooran starts off with a bang! This is full and angling into the stumps, Pooran clears his front leg and crashes it between cover and mid-off!
Short and angled across, Pooran looks to swing it leg side and gets an inside edge through square leg. They get a single and Pooran keeps strike for the final over
Length ball on his hips and Pooran helps it behind square on the leg side in the gap and brings up his highest IPL score.
Slower ball on a length and angled across, Miller slaps it towards cover and gets the danger man Pooran back on strike
Beaten first ball! 144kph length ball angled across, Miller looks to hit it on the up but can't connect
Knocks him over! Off cutter on a length around off, Samad swings for the hills and misses as the ball stays a bit low too, and it just goes off his feet onto the stumps!
Samad gets his first boundary now! A harmless 117kph length ball into his body and Samad pulls it away over square leg!
Russell now goes full outside off, misses the yorker and it ends up being a slot ball, and Pooran launches it down the ground! 24 off the over, wowza!
Russell goes short on leg again, Pooran obliges again! Clears that front leg and hammers it away in front of square for another one-bounce four
And that's gone all the way! Pooran's 150th IPL six! This is short on leg and Pooran pulls it away with disdain!
Just beats deep squaree leg running to his right! Back of length and angled in to Pooran, and he clears his front leg and swings it away in front of square. One bounce and four. 200 up for LSG
Full on leg, Pooran looks to swing it leg side but it just pops back towards the non-striker

Top edge and it bounces short of Harshit Rana running across from deep fine leg. And he makes a mess of it to hand Pooran four runs! This was short on leg and Pooran went for the pull. Wasn't in control at all, but fortune favours the brave?

Pooran takes a blow on his rib cage as he goes across and looks to scoop it fine. This is back of a length angled across. Slower ball as well. Samad and Pooran do well to get a run as Rana sprints to try and effect a run out
Goes for a wide yorker, but it turns into a full toss, but it's good enough to slip under Pooran's bat. No wide called as Pooran had also stepped across
On a length outside off, that seemed to stay a little low, Samad adjusts and tucks it to short fine leg as they scamper for a single
Full outside off, driven out to wide long-off
And that's even bigger! In the slot and he's deposited that well over cow corner to bring up a 21-ball 50! The dugout is up in applause as he raises his bat to acknowledge his team-mates
Longer side or shorter side, it doesn't matter! That's a six on any ground! Rana goes for a back of length slower ball and Pooran gets low and slog-sweeps him over deep midwicket!
Pooran waits on this back of length slower ball angled across him and pulls it out along the carpet to deep midwicket
And now Pooran goes across the stumps to play a scoop, but he falls over and misses the ball. Pace off does the trick for Russell
Oh so stylish! Gets a length ball on his hips, the front foot comes up as he nonchalantly flicks it behind square all the way!
Fullish outside off, Samad clips it down the ground to long-on

And Dre Russ strikes! Short and wide, pace off again, and Marsh looks to slap it away. Can't get the requisite distance on it, it's the longer boundary and the ball only goes to Rinku Singh at deep point
Marsh looks to swing big first up, but the slower back of length delivery outside off beats his outside edge!
And Pooran punishes the extra ball! Gets one in the slot and hits the leather off this one as he crashes it over wide long off!
Another ball outside off that spins away quite wide. Called wide
On a length outside off and spinning away further and Pooran can't reach it
Hammered away! This is full on leg and Pooran gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it 80m over square leg!
This is on a length on off and spinning away. Pooran throws his bat at it and it comes off the toe end to short third
Dropped a little short outside off and spinning in, Marsh goes back and pulls it out to deep midwicket
Great stop from Raghuvanshi right away. Marsh sweeps a full ball outside off hard through square leg. Raghuvanshi has to hare across from deep backward square and does well to save two runs
Tossed up full and wide, Pooran eases a drive to cover
Googly on leg, Pooran tucks it square and gets a couple
On a length and angled across, he slaps it to the off side
Hammered down the ground! And Marsh brings up his highest score of the season. Varun tosses it in the slopt just outside off from around the wicket and Marsh goes downtown
Now Varun fires it in at 111kph outside leg, Pooran looks to heave it leg side and misses and is hit on the pads. They get a leg bye
Tossed up wide, and Pooran says thank you very much! Reaches out and chips it over cover and into the ad boards! That's the shorter side
Full outside off, Marsh tucks it square for a couple of runs. Vaibhav Arora came into this over with just eight runs conceded from two overs. And in this one, he has conceded double of that!
Now Vaibhav goes back of a length and across and Pooran hurries across the stumps and pulls it to deep midwicket's left. The fielder does well to get across and prevent a boundary
Good comeback from Arora, with a 133kph wide yorker nailed to perfection. Pooran can't jam his bat down on it
Dug into the pitch at 125kph, it's going across Marsh and he stands tall and pulls it out on the bounce to deep backward square
Full and that was also sliding down leg, but Marsh just gets the toe end of the bat on it and it races away fine on the leg side for four more!
Rana goes short and across. Goes down leg. Another wide
Now Vaibhav slides one down leg for a wide
Mauled over deep backward square! That's in the slot and on his pads and Marsh will have that for breakfast, lunch and dinner every day! Plays a lovely pickup shot and deposits it in the stands

That was poor from Varun Chakravarthy! This is a length ball outside off and Pooran just opens his bat face to steer it to short third's left. Varun is a bit too slow to get low and it slips past him for Pooran's second boundary today
Goes for the yorker on the legs but it slides down leg as Pooran looks to flick. Second wide of the over
And Pooran joins the party! Johnson goes for a slower ball, but it's on a length and quite wide. Pooran waits on it and cuts it away with a lot of power
Fuller outside off and this time Marsh can only drive it out to sweeper cover for a single
Crrrruuuunnnched away! This is a length ball but with enough width for Marsh to free his arms and slap it away through cover!
Tries the wide yorker, nails the length but not the line. That was outside the tramline and the umpire signals for the extra
Length ball on the pads, Pooran eases it out to deep backward square
Starts off with a beauty! On a length outside off, and it shapes away just a smidge to beat the outside edge. That was bowled at 142kph
Dug in short outside off, Marsh waits on it and slaps it away over cover. The deep fielder runs across but that's placed very well and Marsh brings up his fourth fifty in five matches!
Length ball outside off, slapped away through point to the fielder in the deep
Length ball outside off sits up, Marsh hits a punchy drive to sweeper cover
Short and angled across him, Pooran pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket

What a comeback! Cleans him up with a corker! This is full outside off and it jags in after seaming. Markram is looking to flick and plays all around it and the ball crashes into off and middle stump! Markram misses out on back-to-back fifties, but still, he has given his team a dream start
And Markram welcomes him back with a boundary! Short and wide, Markram steers it fine on the off side
Length on fourth, cut to deep point
Wide on a fullish length, Markram goes for a slog sweep and misses.
Wide and full, slapped to Russell, at long-off, on the bounce. Should he be given an over?
Slips out too wide outside off. This is on a full length, 99ks. Let go
Full and fast on middle, defended to the bowler's left
Wide and full, Marsh slashes hard. Gets it off the bottom of the bat to cover
Short and that's belted wide of deep point. Was a drag-down that got tennis-ball bounce. The angle away was sharp, a free hit effectively

This looked to have turned in a touch, Marsh's front foot was around leg stump and the ball him around the knee-roll after beating the inside edge as he tried to defend it straight. Fullish ball landed around middle and looked like it was heading down leg
Length on middle and leg, 92ks, worked to long-on. No fizz for Narine
Length on leg, flicked to deep-backward square leg
The bad ball comes and Marsh capitalises. Thought it was wide, but no, Marsh showed all his stumps and made the fourth-stump ball look wide. It was shortish and did sit up though, cut through cover
Gentle flick to the edge of the ring at midwicket, Marsh makes Rinku run in from the boundary to pinch two. Risk-free. Was a length ball at the stumps.
Narine gives it a bit of air. 94ks though. Full on middle and leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Beaten on the cut. Marsh's back foot stepped towards the line of the wide-ish ball. Tried to late cut it as the ball past him, was too late on it
100ks full ball looked slower than it was. It angles away towards fifth, got driven to deep point
A measured punch this time, to the right of sweeper cover for a comfy two. Full ball outside off, played with a vertical bat
Sweeps the full ball at the stumps behind square.
Markram, now, tries to leather it. This ball was wide and full, he tried to go lift a drive over cover. Got it to deep point, likely off the bottom of the bat
Harshit saves three at short third. He was a touch wide, dove to the right and got the right hand on it as the ball sped along the ground. Was a wide ball that was cut hard
Pre-meditated lap sweep goes through where leg slip would have been. Short leg chases it to the outfield. Was a length ball around middle and leg, 90ks
This is quicker and at the stumps. More like Narine. Marsh defends with a straight bat
Spins back in to top of middle, Marsh is cramped for room but manages to cut it to cover.

Narine delivers from the front of the hand but lands it a touch too short. Perhaps, Marsh was going on the back foot anyway expecting a compensation in length. Went deep in the crease, got the ball around leg stump and he pulled it behind square
Slog swept 97 metres of square leg. Was a length ball at the stumps, but the spin was taken out of the equation by the impact point being well in front of the body. Looked slow
Spins in froma. fullish length. Landed on leg and nutmegged Marsh on the flick. Hit on the inner-half of the back thigh in the end
Might've nipped back a touch. On a length, landed around fifth and finished around top of fourth. 136ks. Marsh tried to punch it through cover, inside edged it onto pad and then into the off side
Slower ball, Marsh seems to have picked it off the hand. He had width too, the length was too full, so Marsh got on one knee and slapped it high over the bowler
Late cut to deep-backward point from a length
Length around sixth, pulled to long-on. 134ks
Harshit goes wider and touch fuller, on a three-quarter length. Cut to deep-backward point
Yep, Markram uses Harshith's pace and carves the shortish ball over short third. It clears the ropes. Not middled but that was a case of playing the field. Was actually off a length, not a short ball
Short and Markram goes for a powerful pull, mistimes it to deep midwicket. Along the ground

Not far from leg stump. The spin in works against Varun as the ball landed around off and went a touch wide of and over leg stump. Markram went across to fourth stump for a pre-meditated slog sweep and missed it.

Spins away from the bat, bounces more than Markram expected. His back springs up as he pats it towards backward point. That landed on a fuller side of length around fourth and finished around top of fifth
Full on leg, 95ks, flicked to square leg
Length on leg, sharp turn. 93ks. Ball beats the flick and deflects towards point
Spins back from off to leg, gets good bounce from a slightly short length. Markram backs away and punches it firmly to long-on
Length on leg, flicked through midwicket
This is nailed. Half-tracker rises around top-of-thigh high, Markram stands beside it and pulls it over midwicket

More intent runs. Markram doesn't middle the slug across the line, was a slot ball around fourth, went off the inner-half of the bat as the face closed upon impact. But the power was enough to race across the outfield
Johnson goes wide yorker; Markram gets on one knee, reaches out and creams a horizontal-bat drive along the ground. Sweeper cover moves right to stop it
Markram manufactures a slash over mid-off. Makes room, almost too much, for the full ball arrowing around middle. The ball went off the toe of the bat but cleared the infield
Back of length over fifth, sharp angle, one-legged pull goes into the ground. To long leg it goes.
Quick single to the left of mid-off. Full ball on fourth pushed gently
Markram cuts this time, trying to power it like Marsh. Gets it off the bottom of the bat to sweeper cover. This ball was short and wide.
Punches the fullish ball on leg to long-on
Uppish flick takes the inswinger on middle to the right of midwicket
Touch fuller and a lot straighter. It's angling in to off stump and Marsh's feet are jammed as he defends to the bowler's right
Marsh flashes after seeing width, but cloths it to cover point. Was a sixth-stump three-quarter-length ball at 131ks, Marsh went deep in the crease and cut hard
Pulled off the bottom-half of the bat, gets it to deep fine leg. Not that short a ball, was around the fourth-stump line
Fullish on middle, defended to the bowler. 140ks

Mowed high and far, second tier at least. Was ashort boundary over square leg, this one went 95 metres far. Was fullish on fourth, treated like a slot ball. Stable base, free swing across the line, from around knee-height
Length ball angles away through fifth, Markram frees his arms and square drives it late. Gets it to deep third
Overpitched on middle and Markram eases the flick through midwicket. The hands came top to bottom but the bat face was closed, was a slicy shot.
Bumper to begin, it's over leg stump and around the top of Markram's left shoulder. He swivelled to get inside the line and pull it fine. Gloves were close but there was no contact. 135ks
Fullish around leg, clipped to midwicket
Marsh walks down and across to negate the movement. Ball's on the shorter side of length, finishes over fourth stump. Left alone

Big inswing, big appeal for lbw from Arora. Not given. He checks if height is the issue, replay shows there was an inside edge. Was a fullish ball that started wide but finished around off. Marsh tried to block it with the vertical bat next to the front pad.

Almost a drag on. The length ball around fourth seemed to have slowed off the pitch, Markram's back foot went across a touch for a square cut. Didn't get the room or bounce to work with, luckily for him, the under-edge went past leg stump and through fine leg.
Touch fuller, keeping the stumps in play. Markram flicks to midwicket
Not right away, good length though. At the body, decent bounce. Markram is on the back foot as he defends straight.
Rinku Singh finishes it off with a six, but it's LSG who will leave the Eden Gardens with the two points! Rinku nails the slog sweep over deep midwicket, but LSG seal a four-wicket win!
Tossed up full on off, Rinku gets down on one knee and launches it down the ground. Gets another boundary, to help the run rate
Length ball across him, Rinku slaps it away for four on the off side, but that should be enough for LSG!
Length ball on middle, Harshit pokes it towards short third and takes off for a single. There isa a misfield by Avesh, but they don't take the second
Now Rana has a big swing down the ground but misses!
Harshit Rana, you beauty! Skips down the track to a length legbreak and slaps it away between over point! 20 needed off 5 now!
Finishes the over in style! This is an attempted yorker on off, but Rinku just drills this through cover!
Full outside off, he drives it out to long-off but turns down the run again
Full around leg, Rinku clears his front leg and smashes it down the ground, but can't beat wide long-on to his right! He doesn't take a run
Avesh retorts with a yorker around middle and leg that Rinku manages to keep out
And now he goes the other way! Full and slanted across him, and Rinku nonchalantly lofts it over extra cover! One bounce four!
Rinku Singh! Gets one full around leg and just clears his front leg to heave it over midwicket!
On a length around middle, he rocks back and pulls it down the ground to long-on
Wrong'un on a length around middle and off, and it spins away to beat Rinku's swing
Nails the reverse-sweep this time! Full around leg and he drills it through cover
Rinky shapes for the reverse-shot and Rathi tosses it wide, but it's a bit too wide for the umpire's liking
Now Harshit has a wild slog but misses and the ball goes off his thigh to the keeper's left. They race for the single
Floated full around leg, Harshit skips down the track but ends up just defending it back to the bowler
Flung full on leg, Harshit can only tap it square on the leg side
Full toss around off and Rinku goes hard with a drive past cover, just beating the fielder to his right!
Bouncer around leg, Rinku ducks under it

Full outside off and he drives it back straight, it crashes into the stumps at the non-striker's end and they manage a single. Shardul stretched out for it but didn't get a finger on that, although Rinku had put his bat back at the crease in time. The deflection allowed the single
Wide yorker, just inside the line, and it beats the bat as Rana looks to jam it down

Harshit Rana gets off the mark with a boundary! Gets one short and wide and he cuts it hard over backward point. Samad from deep third runs to his right but it bounces just short of him and sneaks under him

Shardul Thakur gets the big scalp of Andre Russell! And he has done it with another full toss! This is a low full toss outside off, Russell looks to muscle it down the ground but can't get under it enough. Good catch from Miller running in from long-off and it looks like LSG are favourites again!
Yorker outside leg, Russell manages to squeeze it out through backward square for a single. He stops the sequence of wickets off the final ball of the over!
And Russell announces himself in style! That's the kind of delivery he absolutely loves, in the slot on leg. Clears his front leg and fires it into the stands over deep midwicket! Monster hit!
Short outside off, Russell looks to ramp it but can't connect
Full ball slanted across him, Rinku opens the face to steer it to deep third

And another one bites the dust! Venkatesh looks to take on another full ball around off but mistimes this as it goes high in the air. Markram makes no mistake coming in from long-on! LSG right back in this!
Handsome drive, that! This is full outside off and Venkatesh lofts it inside out over cover for a one-bounce four!

The wicket falls indeed! Raghuvanshi looks to reverse-ramp this low yorker outside off and makes a mess of it, just lobbing it up for a simple catch for Rishabh Pant behind the stumps! Avesh has been excellent in his last two overs and he gets a reward for it!
And now Raghuvanshi breaks KKR's boundary drought. Avesh doesn't do too much wrong with that wide yorker, but he opens the face and jams his bat down to lift it over point
Angkrish goes across the stumps and looks to sweep, but misses. Pant appeals for caught behind, but Avesh tells him that's not hit anything. May have come off his pad, though the replay suggests
Full on the stumps, Venkatesh digs it out towards long-off
Avesh nails the wide yorker and Raghuvanshi squeezes it out square on the off side. Gets a single to start
Goes for a yorker on leg, misses the length by very little, and that allows Venkatesh to drive it down the ground to long-on

Holes out at long-off! This is tossed up very full, in the slot, but Ramandeep doesn't get the distance he wants on that! Lofts it down the ground but straight to Aiden Markram, who hops as he takes it reverse-cupped in front of his face
Venkatesh moves across the stumps again and Bishnoi ends up bowling a full toss that the batter sweeps out to deep square leg
Googly outside off, Ramandeep eases it square on the off side for a single to get off the mark
Full on the stumps, Venkatesh had moved across and looks to sweep and just gets a bottom edge to squeeze it out fine on the leg side
Bishnoi sees Venkatesh go across his stumps and tosses it wide. Venkatesh misses his attempted swipe
Full ball outside off driven to cover

Bishnoi bowls it wide as he sees Venkatesh going for the switch hit. Pant takes the bails off quickly but Venkatesh had his foot firmly planted inside the crease. The batter however does review for the wide not given! There is also an umpire review for stumping, for what that's worth. Looks like it is a wide.  But wait, as Pant threw the ball onto the stumps, Venkatesh's foot could be above the ground! But no, the third umpire adjudges his foot to have come down just in time, although I have my doubts about that decision

Chipped straight to cover! The Lord works in mysterious ways! Innocuous full toss outside off and Rahane gives Pooran catching practice! Juest doesn't get any height or power on it and Rahane walks back with KKR needing 77 in 42!
Slower ball, full outside off, Rahane goes across, waits on it and flicks it in front of square leg. Samad does well to stop it as the KKR skipper adds two to his tally
Edge goes over a leaping Pant! Short outside off, Rahane looks to cut and gets a thick edge and picks up a fortunate boundary!
On a length outside off, Rahane reaches out and slaps it to the cover fielder
Shardul ends up bowling a full toss at the stumps and Venkatesh drives it out to long-off
Another wide yorker, Rahane moves across and drives it out to sweeper cover

Another wide yorker, Rahane moves across and looks to drive and misses. But given wide much to the dismay of the bowler and Pant. Shardul asks if it should be reviewed, but Pant says no. Replay shows it was just over the line. Rahane had not made any movement across, so the review likely would have been wasted
And now the ball slips out of his hand as he registers four wides on the trot!
Another wide yorker outside the tramline! Oh a game of such small margins! Shardul nailing the lengths, but erring ever so little on the line!
Another wide yorker goes too wide!
Starts off with a wide yorker, but misses his line. Will have to rebowl that one

Through the diving long-off fielder! This is full outside off and Venkatesh creams a drive wide of long-off. The ball scorches the surface and goes over the practice pitches. Bishnoi is sprinting to his right but he can't quite stop it and ends up going over the ball
Length ball outside off, clipped through midwicket and this time it's just one run
ON a length on off, Rahane, standing deep in his crease, flicks it through midwicket and they sprint for two
Length ball angled across him, slapped away to deep point
This time he nails the switch-hit! On a length around off and he helps it over short fine! 50 ball stand up in 30 balls
Tossed up at 84kph and it beats the outside edge as Venkatesh looks to drive
Rathi toesses it up quite wide as Venkatesh looks for the reverse-sweep. Venkatesh has an enquiry and the umpire does give it wide
Slower length ball outside off, Rahane goes to cut but can only get an inside edge onto the ground and through to the keeper
Avesh goes for a wide yorker now, squeezed to cover off the toe end
Ajinkya Rahane, is that really you? Goes across the stumps to a full ball outside off and just paddles it fine down the leg side. Brings up a 26-ball half-century!
Avesh continues to go for his yorkers and this time Venkatesh is able to drive it out to deep point

Venkatesh makes room leg side early and Avesh goes yorker length again. Venkatesh manages to drag the ball onto his thigh as he tries to squeeze it out. Looks like he has hurt his right thigh! Getting some treatment now
Avesh starts off with a 133kph yorker around middle and leg, Venkatesh digs it out towards long-on and gets a brace
Length around fifth, 91ks, worked to long-on
Full ball on fourth is quick and beats the pre-meditated reverse sweep
High ball... goes long too! Clears long-on easily. Big front stride from Iyer, step-hit the slot ball with the weight fully forward.
Bishnoi goes wide again but the angle is much too sharp. The length ball is let go
Wide on a length, doesn't bounce much. Likely why Iyer mistimed the cut into the pitch in front
Length on leg, clipped through square leg
Skiddy ball but Rahane's back foot goes deep in the crease, he lunges deep too to cut it through backward point

Edge deflects off Pant's gloves to the deep-third boundary. Iyer, who was deep in the crease, looked to whack a cover drive off the back foot and got a thickish edge. The ball hit the flap of Pant's glove and raced fine. Was a length ball angling away just outside off
Wide on a length, slashed to backward point
Length on fifth, guided to backward point. Carrom-ball release from Rathi
Length over fifth, whipped to long-on
Length around fifth, square driven to cover point
Wide on a length, cut gently to the left of deep point
Pulled hard. Along the ground. Between long-on and deep midwicket. Not too short, rose over the knee and Venky lumped it while standing mostly upright
Spins back after landing around fourth. The length ball is flicked to long-on. 94ks
Length on top of fifth, no spin, cut to backward point on the bounce
Easy easy... nooo! is the yell from Pant. Cover moved to the left and couldn't pick the ball up later. Was a wide ball on a length
Very wide. Pant has to go outside the edge of the pitch to collect it
Akash misfields at short third and allows four. It bounced extra and turned to his right. Frustration for Bishnoi.
Wide on a length, underedged cut goes back to the bowler
Wide on a length, driven to deep point
Worked off the back foot to long-on
Beaten on the lofted reverse sweep. Iyer changed his stance very late there. Pant can't collect it properly
Quicker, flat googly at 95ks lands around fourth and skids away off a length. Iyer guides it behind point

Wide, slashed, and it's taken at long-off. Rathi continues the write-off celebration but on the grass. Great loophole if he's found one. Was a fullish ball that was wide, spun away too. Narine slashed and got it off the bottom of the bat
Length on fourth, square driven to deep point
Wide of the crease again, another yorker attempt. This is a full toss around knee-roll height that's flicked to deep square leg
And Avesh does bowl at the stumps, nails the yorker while at it. Rahane jams it back to the bowler, who keeps the batter in check with a direct hit at the stumps.
Overpitched on fifth, that's enough width for a smother-drive through extra cover. On one knee too, stylish from Rahane
Helped away again, over square leg - maybe just behind - for another biggie. It's on the pads, Rahane's inside the line of the ball and flicks it

Rahane tries to hit the ball harder this time, gets it off the splice into the pitch. Was a horizontal-bat swipe and Rahane practices a straight-bat drive later. Was a three-quarter length ball on fifth
Wide-of-the-crease release, but doesn't matter to Rahane. He uses the angle in and the even bounce from a length to pull it over square leg. 91 metres! That was timing over muscle
Slower, into the pitch, sits up. Narine backs away and carves it over cover
Full on leg, worked to deep-backward square leg
Yorker on fourth, jammed back to the bowler
Full and slow on fourth, worked back to the bowler
That's a crazy good square drive. Deep third was square but had no chance as the ball raced along the grass. Was a good ball, length around fourth. Test stuff, responded with the same thing
Fullish n off, 137ks, but it's made to look like a worse ball than it was. Rahane moved across and flicked it behind square
Narine walks across towards the line, gets on the front stool and boshes the full ball over cover. Got it on the half-volley, very square
The wide ploy continues. Thakur goes length but Narine leaves to pick up another extra. Been a lot of those already
Length outside off, Narine cuts hard but mistimes it to cover

Bowler goes wide again, Narine steps across late but decides to leave it. Ball goes past the tramline but a review would be risky as Narine's initial position was prolly not across. Pant grimaces and decides to let it go
Wide on a length, Narine swipes again but this isn't in his reach.

One-handed flay over cover, taken by the lidded boundary boy over extra cover. Was a cutter on a length that kept going away outside off, went off the bottom of the bat. Narine taking his hand off helped with the reach
Slower one is left alone, Narine might've thought that was wide. But the length went well inside the tramline and on the bounce to the keeper
Movement away, might've been off the pitch. Rahane uses it to guide the length ball to deep-backward point
Oh, Miller looks hurt. He went to the left and tried to palm the travelling ball. Ended up tipping it onto his throat. He's okay to continue. Slower one was full and drifts in, driven hard by Narine
Length ball is helped off the hips with a flick. Too fine for long leg to cut off
Edge flies between slip and gully, closer to gully in fact. Went low, but well out of Rathi's reach. Was a rising length ball around fifth, Rahane tried to square drive it on top of the bounce
Three-quarter length just outside off, square driven to point

Another review, no hesitation from Pant after it was given not out. Where was this pitching? Was a length ball on middle that beat the swing across the line and hit QDK on the back leg. Might've seamed back in a touch. Ball-tracking says... it pitched just in line with leg and hit middle and off three-fourth of the way up! Pant and Co punch the air as the replay comes on the big screen. Brave call to review after losing one the last ball but it pays off.

Arguably the ball of the day. It's full but not half-volley, 139ks, lands around middle and jags away. QDK stood well leg side of the ball and his body froze momentarily with his hands trying the punch the ball on the rise. Pant checks with his mates if there was a nick, no agreement but he reviews anyway. It's close but no edge, LSG burn a review.
Akash continues to miss his line. This isn't wide, just on the pads, but it's off a fullish length and QDK's able to pick it up over short fine leg with a flick

Another edge, this goes fine of short third. Another cutter, on a length again. Narine didn't change his stance this time, just tried to flay it again. Luckier this time as it went at a catching height
Slower one. Narine delays his shot but gives it his all while tryna carve it off a length while reaching out with one leg. The edge goes well over short third
Three-quarter length on off, guided to deep third. 134ks
Wide on a length, cut off the bottom of the bat to cover point
Shortish ball is blocked back to the bowler
Overpitched and QDK launches a 75-metre flick over long-on
Length on fourth, guided to deep third

Akash rattles Narine with a 137ks bumper. That rose only around stomach-height but Narine took his eyes off, bobbed his head towards square leg while half-pulling. The ball went off the edge to deep square leg on the bounce
Another yorker. Narine tries to flick, nutmegs himself. Ball goes between his feet, to short fine leg
Middle-stump half-volley. Narine slides his front foot leg side while lifting it with a flick. The boundary boy over the midwicket ropes takes the catch
Full ball is just down leg, beaten on te flick but that's the third wide of the over
Goes for the on-stump yorker. Ends up with a low full toss on leg, Narine tries to whip it and gets hit on the pad

Pant saves four by running and then diving to parry the full ball towards short fine leg. This was like a wide yorker to a rhb. Akash getting it to swing in but from that line it's only gonna hurt him
QDK helps it along the hips with a flick. On the bounce to deep fine leg
Wide well down leg, five bonus to begin. The length ball strayed well down leg and Pant's dive was beaten
